If you want the agent to design a new flyer, menu or post from one sentence and hand back a file where every line is still editable text, use a brief-to-layout design MCP such as Krumzi. The rest of this guide shows what each one actually returns, what it costs, and the real output from a one-sentence flyer brief we ran through an MCP on 19 November 2026.

## Is there a Canva MCP? [...] ## One honest limitation

Krumzi isn't listed in the Official MCP Registry or in Claude's connector directory yet. Canva and Figma are in both. In practice, that means you connect Krumzi by pasting its server URL as a custom connector, while Canva shows up in the directories your AI client browses. The setup is one paste and one approval, but it's a step you take yourself.

## The takeaway

If you're asking "is there a Canva MCP?", the answer is yes, and it's the right choice when the agent's job is to work inside your Canva account. If the job is to design something new that you can still edit, the better question is what the agent hands back. A layered, editable layout beats a flat image every time a date changes.

results.content:
## What Canva MCP is

MCP is the standard that lets an AI assistant such as ChatGPT or Claude use another app on your behalf. "Canva MCP" is Canva's version of that. Once it is connected, you can ask for "a flyer for our Saturday market," see design options in the chat, and open the one you like in Canva to finish it.

The same Canva login works across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and a longer list of other AI tools (Canva help: AI assistants and tools).

## Is there an official one?

Yes. Canva built and runs it, and it comes ready-made for both big assistants: [...] ### What is the Canva MCP server?

It is the service behind Canva's AI Connector, which ChatGPT, Claude and other assistants use to reach your Canva account. Canva's separate Dev MCP server is for developers building Canva apps.

## The bottom line

Canva has an official connector for both ChatGPT and Claude, setup takes a few clicks with your Canva login, and it works on Canva Free. It can create, edit, resize and export real designs, and it spends your Canva AI allowance as it goes. For making designs from a chat, start there. If you also need those designs posted, scheduled and measured, add Helena in the same Claude chat.

results.title: Building the design layer of the internet: opening Canva to every agent and developer
results.content:
An idea might start in a conversation with an AI assistant or a task handed to an agent, but bringing it to life for other people usually means creating something visual, like a presentation or a social campaign. With today's updates, our design tools are there wherever this work happens. Our early investment in the Model Context Protocol, or MCP, laid the foundations, and today the Canva MCP server⁠(opens in a new tab or window) powers millions of design tasks inside AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Muse. Now, we're expanding what you and your agents can build with it

We're making it easier for agents to discover and use our tools and models. We're also introducing new REST APIs and an expanded Canva CLI alongside MCP, giving you more ways to build with Canva. [...] We've redesigned Canva MCP around this. We've consolidated overlapping capabilities and made it simpler for agents, even those running on less powerful models, to use the tools well. This reduces ambiguity for an agent deciding what to call and helps it reach the right result using less context.

We’re also adding the capabilities agents are asked for most often. An agent can now turn to Canva to generate an editable design, standalone image or video, remove a background, turn a flat image or graphic into an editable layered design, resize creative, and export the finished result. Agents can also retrieve existing designs and templates and personalize content using data. [...] 1. Building the design layer of the internet: opening Canva to every agent and developer

> Canva is opening its creative platform to the AI ecosystem, making Canva MCP generally available and giving agents, assistants and applications more ways to create. Redesigned architecture, new REST APIs and expanded CLI support let you bring editable design, image and video generation capabilities directly into products and automated workflows.

TL;DR
